answer_text: For any right triangle, squaring both legs and adding the results gives the square of the hypotenuse, the side opposite the 90-degree angle — written as a² + b² = c² — so a triangle with legs 3 and 4 has hypotenuse 5, since 9 + 16 = 25 and √25 = 5; this lets you solve for an unknown side and underlies the distance formula in coordinate geometry.
